records.observation: Large gray tilted panels and an upright sheet enclose the blue slats above a curved shell. These overlapping surfaces impair the body and do not convincingly support an accessible working seat.
A long narrow gray panel is separated below the floating blue seat, with no usable legs or end supports. The body is incomplete and the blue and gray layers remain visibly apart in the oblique views.

The gray body has a lower seat plank, end supports and an upright back, forming a recognizable bench. The blue seat floats higher than the gray sitting plank and interrupts the back region rather than defining the working seat.

A coherent gray slatted bench with backrest, legs and lower brace remains. Its gray seat boards lie above the blue curved strip, leaving the preserved condition below the actual seating surface in the side section.
